seo.title: Storefront — the commerce platform built for the agent era | Stella
seo.description: Stella is a complete commerce backend — catalog, cart, checkout, accounts, and local payments — built from day one for the world where AI agents shop on behalf of your customers. Run your store today. Win the agent era tomorrow.

hero.headline:
Built for shoppers.
Ready for agents.
hero.sub: The only commerce backend in Nepal built from day one for the world where AI agents buy on behalf of your customers.
hero.supportingLine: Live in days, not months. eSewa and Khalti included.

pillars.heading: Everything your store needs in one platform.
pillars.sub: No stitching together a cart from one vendor, a checkout from another, and a payment integration from a freelancer. Stella ships as one connected platform — built, hosted, and supported in Nepal.

agentEra.heading: Your next customer might not be a person.
agentEra.sub: It might be the assistant they sent. If your store can't talk to it, the sale goes to one that can.
agentEra.body: The way people shop online is changing. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and a wave of new shopping assistants are starting to buy on behalf of their users — comparing options, checking stock, completing the order. Most stores aren't ready for this. They have no way to authenticate an agent, no way to set a budget cap, no way to log what was actually purchased and why.

mock.intent: wants to buy on your behalf

agentEra.footnote: You don't have to do anything special to turn this on. If you're on Stella, your store is already an agent-ready store.

everySurface.heading: One store. Every surface.
everySurface.sub: Your catalog, your prices, your stock — everywhere your shoppers are, including the channels that don't exist yet.
everySurface.footnote: One inventory, one customer record, one source of truth across every surface.

closingCta.heading: See Stella running your store.
closingCta.sub: A 15-minute call. We'll connect your products live and walk you through what your store looks like to a customer, to an AI agent, and to you on the dashboard. No slides, just the real thing.
closingCta.footnote: Live in days, not months. eSewa and Khalti included.
